trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: If scientists would have been listened to, we would have fewer floods now.
trap.right: If scientists had been listened to, we would have fewer floods now.
trap.why: Português usa “tivessem sido ouvidos”; o brasileiro usa would na if. Misto: if + had been + particípio, would + base.

mcq.q: If we had acted, we **___** safer now.
If scientists **___** listened to, we’d be safe.

fix.wrong: If scientists would have been heard, floods wouldn’t happen.
fix.right: If scientists had been heard, floods wouldn’t be so frequent.

fix.wrong: If we have acted earlier, we would be safe.
fix.right: If we had acted earlier, we would be safe.

fix.wrong: If they had been warned, they will be safe now.
fix.right: If they had been warned, they would be safe now.

rewrite.prompt: Combine: “Nobody listened to scientists, so we have floods.”
rewrite.answer: If scientists had been listened to, we wouldn’t have floods.

rewrite.prompt: Combine: “We didn’t act, so we aren’t safe.”
rewrite.answer: If we had acted, we would be safe.

rewrite.prompt: Passiva: “If they had warned us, we would be safe.”
rewrite.answer: If we had been warned, we would be safe.
